checks: Confirm the window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and pull all events since last review: falls, ED visits, hospital admissions, and any observation stays, with dates and discharge summaries.

New atrial fibrillation (apixaban started 2026-10-26): verify the ECG source, rate/rhythm documentation, and whether cardiology follow-up is scheduled. Review bleeding signals (gum/nose bleeding, melena, hematuria, bruising, falls with head strike) given apixaban plus clopidogrel plus simvastatin and metoprolol context, and confirm the team has documented the anticoagulant indication and dose review.

Kidney function trend: review creatinine, eGFR, potassium, and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio over the window given CKD stage 3 with diabetic kidney disease and proteinuria. Check whether apixaban dosing criteria (age, weight, creatinine) have been reviewed against the latest labs.

Medication reconciliation: several agents started 2026-07-24 (tacrolimus Envarsus, lisinopril, hydrochlorothiazide, amlodipine, Humulin insulin, acetaminophen). Flag that tacrolimus is an immunosuppressant with no matching indication on the conditions list, and confirm prescriber, indication, and monitoring levels. Check for any starts or stops in the window and for duplicate antihypertensive or ACE/potassium-related combinations.

Blood glucose and insulin safety: review home or facility glucose logs, hypoglycemia episodes, and A1c timing given insulin use in a participant with prediabetes listed alongside diabetic kidney disease. Confirm the diabetes diagnosis is reconciled with the conditions list.

Blood pressure and orthostatic check: review BP trend across the window with the recent multi-agent regimen (lisinopril, HCTZ, amlodipine, metoprolol). Check for orthostatic symptoms, dizziness, and any falls linked to BP changes.
Weight trend and nutrition: compare weights across the window given BMI 30+ history, diuretic use, and any appetite or intake change. Check for edema related to amlodipine or heart failure signs.

Pain management: review chronic low back pain and chronic pain scores, acetaminophen use and daily total, and any new analgesic requests. Check that no NSAID has been added given CKD and anticoagulation.
Prostate history (carcinoma in situ): check for urinary symptoms, hematuria, and any urology follow-up due in the window. Confirm the status of this diagnosis.

Function, cognition, mood, and caregiver: review ADL/IADL changes, cognition screen results, depression screen, social participation and attendance at PACE programs, transport, caregiver strain, and any care-plan items due (reassessments, goals, advance directive or code status review) in the window before the 2026-11-30 IDT review.
